baseline_models.focus_anchor: Negated first-person أَدْرِ at word 2 governs the possessive حِسَابِيَهْ at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Direct knowing is denied while its object is an exact personal reckoning, creating estrangement between the speaker and an evaluation already his.

activation_trace.role: Knowing and awareness is directly negated, supplying the epistemic gap.
Counting and reckoning supplies the exact personal evaluation that remains unknown.

changed_reading.before: The speaker is merely surprised by an unspecified outcome.
changed_reading.after: He confesses estrangement from an exact reckoning that is already personally his.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَدْرِ denies direct awareness beside حِسَابِيَهْ, whose root can also name supposition.
baseline_models.mechanism: The account resonates with the speaker's own reckoning or assumption, so the clause marks failure to move from conjectural self-estimation into knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Knowing and awareness supplies the threshold the speaker never reached.
Reckoning as supposition makes the account resonate with an unverified self-estimate.

changed_reading.before: He lacks access to a numerical total.
changed_reading.after: His prior way of reckoning remained guesswork and never became reliable knowledge of his standing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: حِسَابِيَهْ at word 4 can activate the sufficiency branch of ح س ب while remaining the object of negated أَدْرِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The unknown is not only how much is counted but what would be enough; ignorance concerns the adequacy of whatever the speaker imagined could support him.

activation_trace.role: Negated awareness makes adequacy itself an unrecognized question.
Sufficiency and enoughness turns the account into a test of what can actually avail.

changed_reading.before: The unknown is the amount of a score.
changed_reading.after: The unknown is also what, if anything, could count as sufficient in the speaker's case.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive حِسَابِيَهْ makes the supervised and investigated matter the speaker's own, while أَدْرِ denies achieved awareness.
baseline_models.mechanism: Accountable supervision and information-testing recast the line as failed self-audit: the speaker did not examine or manage his case into knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Knowing and awareness supplies the failed result of the audit.
Supervision and accountable management makes the account an administered case rather than a bare sum.
Seeking and testing information supplies the investigation that failed to become knowledge.

changed_reading.before: Ignorance is a passive lack of disclosed information.
changed_reading.after: Ignorance also reads as neglected accountable self-inspection of a case already one's own.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening asks what can cause knowledge of the Reality, while the focus speaker negates that knowing frame before his personal account. The account becomes a binding realization of the Reality he failed to apprehend.

activation_trace.role: Negated knowing anchors the eventual confession.
Reality fixed against falsehood gives the account objective status beyond self-estimate.
A binding fixed due makes that reality function as an obligation coming home to the speaker.

structural_cues: 69:3 and 69:26 mirror a مَا plus د ر ي plus مَا frame while reversing second-person causation into first-person negation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored knowing frames and fixed-reality branches; I infer that the confession embodies failed apprehension of the opening challenge, while simple rhetorical recurrence remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The line reports uncertainty about a private calculation.
changed_reading.after: The line enacts the opening knowledge problem: the speaker's account is where binding Reality becomes undeniable too late.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning is made a reminder, is to be held inwardly by a receptive ear, and later functions protectively. Focus ignorance can therefore be failed uptake and retention, not complete absence of warning.

activation_trace.role: Negated awareness anchors failed reception in the focus clause.
An active reminder supplies knowledge material available before the account arrives.
Holding meaning in the heart supplies the retention mechanism whose failure can end in not knowing.
Listening and accepting makes reception active rather than mere exposure to sound.
Placing oneself in protection gives retained reminder a preventive function.

structural_cues: The purpose clause at 69:12 joins reminder to doubled و ع ي and a receptive ear; 69:48 later identifies a protected receptive group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reminder, retention, accepted hearing, and protection; I supply the arrow from failed reception to focus ignorance, while these verses may instead describe an ideal audience without diagnosing this speaker.

changed_reading.before: The speaker simply lacked information about the account.
changed_reading.after: His not-knowing can be failure to receive and preserve information meant to become protective awareness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Presentation for inspection and removal of hiddenness turn the account into an exposure event. What the speaker did not know about his case becomes inspectable when no concealed element remains.

activation_trace.role: Negated awareness supplies the concealed side of the transition.
Accountable supervision makes the exposed object an inspected case.
Bringing something out for viewing supplies the public inspection stage.
Removing concealment supplies the reversal from unknown case to exposed case.

structural_cues: The universal negation at 69:18 allows no hidden exception and precedes both recipients' speeches.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies presentation and total removal of hiddenness; I infer that the personal account is disclosed within that exposure, while presentation of persons and reckoning may remain distinct operations.

changed_reading.before: The account is an unseen number the speaker happens not to possess.
changed_reading.after: The account is forced inspection of a formerly concealed personal case, making ignorance unsustainable.

context_deltas.mechanism: A written record can be read aloud, its writing establishes judgment, and the successful recipient names the same personal account. حساب materializes as a legible dossier rather than an abstract result alone.

activation_trace.role: Counting and reckoning anchors the personal account being materialized.
Ordered letters and the written object supplies the account's readable record form.
Written establishment imposing judgment gives the dossier legal force.
Reading and recitation makes the record publicly inspectable.

structural_cues: Both recipients receive a possessive book, and حِسَابِيَهْ closes both 69:20 and 69:26.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a readable, judgment-bearing book beside the repeated account; I infer that the book embodies the accounting dossier, while it may instead be evidence used in a distinct reckoning.

changed_reading.before: The account is an intangible result.
changed_reading.after: The account arrives as a possessive, readable, judgment-bearing dossier that can no longer remain abstract.

context_deltas.mechanism: The successful recipient claims sign-based conviction that he would meet his account, not advance knowledge of a favorable score. The focus ignorance becomes failure to reckon with encounter itself rather than failure to predict its result.

activation_trace.role: Negated direct awareness anchors the losing recipient's posture.
Conviction after an indication supplies anticipatory trust without foreknowledge of verdict.
Two things coming face to face makes accountability an encounter rather than a distant computation.

structural_cues: The parallel speeches share first-person possessive cadence and the exact endpoint حِسَابِيَهْ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel speeches, conviction, and encounter; I infer that prior orientation toward accountability is decisive, while ظن may only express a general expectation with no intended ethical contrast.

changed_reading.before: The speaker failed to know whether his score would be good or bad.
changed_reading.after: He failed to live as someone who expected his own reckoning to meet him at all.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speaker wishes the left-side book had never been given, then says he did not know his account. Because knowledge arrives in a handed, judgment-establishing record, ignorance is colored by aversion to legal recognition rather than innocent curiosity.

activation_trace.role: Negated knowing anchors the confession following the wish.
Giving supplies the transfer that puts the record and its knowledge into the speaker's possession.
Written establishment imposing judgment explains why receipt makes the account operative and feared.
The left direction supplies the marked polarity against the right-side scene.

structural_cues: The wish not to receive the book and the focus confession are consecutive first-person laments.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unwanted giving, a legally forceful book, left-right polarity, and immediate sequence; I infer aversion colors the ignorance, while the laments may be psychologically independent.

changed_reading.before: Not knowing is a neutral deficit the speaker regrets.
changed_reading.after: Not knowing is entangled with wishing the record had never arrived to make accountability recognizable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus sufficiency branch is answered by wealth that does not suffice or avail. The account tests supports the speaker treated as enough, and amassed wealth fails.

activation_trace.role: Sufficiency and enoughness makes the personal account a test of what can avail.
Sufficiency and adequacy supplies the explicit failed support answering the focus branch.
Possessing and amassing wealth identifies the resource that proves insufficient.

structural_cues: حِسَابِيَهْ and مَالِيَهْ are parallel first-person possessions in the same lament sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matching sufficiency branches and immediately names wealth; I infer the account audits supposed supports, while wealth may merely fail after a verdict already reached.

changed_reading.before: The speaker did not know the numerical result.
changed_reading.after: He did not understand what could count as enough, and his wealth fails that sufficiency test.

context_deltas.mechanism: Punishment is explained through failed trust and failure even to urge feeding a person in abasement. The account is an administered relational audit counting omissions and neglected social influence, not only private acts.

activation_trace.role: Accountable supervision supplies the audit structure into which the charges fit.
Heart-settling trust supplies the Godward relation whose negation becomes one charge.
Urging action supplies a social capacity whose omission is counted.
Feeding another identifies the material care the speaker failed even to promote.
Abasement and poverty identifies the vulnerable relation against which omission is measured.

structural_cues: The explanatory إِنَّهُ كَانَ introduces grounds for punishment, and paired negations join failed belief with failure to encourage feeding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explanatory syntax and two failures; I infer these are criteria in the personal account, while they may instead be a non-exhaustive character sketch rather than ledger categories.

changed_reading.before: The account is a private score of committed acts.
changed_reading.after: The account audits trust, social relation, and omitted advocacy for another's sustenance, including what was never set in motion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The evaluator knows the deniers; covering truth ends in uncovering and regret; fixed reality then removes doubt. Focus not-knowing becomes asymmetrical and temporary, a self-obscured estimate overruled by certainty.

activation_trace.role: Negated awareness anchors the human side of the knowledge asymmetry.
Reckoning as supposition supplies the unstable self-estimate displaced at disclosure.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the evaluator's already achieved knowledge.
Actively attributing falsehood identifies denial as a stance rather than lack of data.
Removing a covering supplies the moment the obscured case is exposed.
Regret over what is missed supplies the affective result of late exposure.
Veiling truth supplies the self-obscuring condition that uncovering reverses.
Reality fixed against falsehood defeats private supposition.
Stable knowledge with doubt removed supplies the terminal epistemic state.

structural_cues: 69:49-51 moves through emphatic divine knowledge, denial, regret, and a final declaration of fixed certainty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies knowledge, denial, covering, uncovering, regret, and certainty; I supply causal arrows from denial to self-obscuration and exposure to certainty, while the roots may label adjacent states without one causal chain.

changed_reading.before: No one yet knows the speaker's uncertain score.
changed_reading.after: The evaluator already knows his stance; denial covers the case only from him until exposure converts supposition into regretful certainty.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's split mapping from focus د ر ي to dominant Furuq د ر ر and crosses from knowing into material yield. It remains anchored through the focus occurrence and ح س ب counting, with nearby fruit and prior-advance branches forming a coherent return mechanism. Render it only as a split-root resonance, never as a replacement lexical meaning for أَدْرِ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet maps focus أَدْرِ at word 2 to a د ر ر yield branch as well as direct د ر ي knowing, while حِسَابِيَهْ at word 4 anchors the result as an account.

activation_trace.role: Abundant issuing from a source supplies the exploratory image of a life yielding its accumulated return.
Counting and reckoning keeps the yielded return anchored as the speaker's account.
Plucked fruit and a near cluster supplies the harvest image for a matured favorable return.
Value advanced beforehand supplies the input from which the later account can yield a return.

changed_reading.before: The account is a static total disclosed at judgment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is the matured yield released from what a life advanced, and the speaker failed to grasp what his source would produce.

strongest_changes: The mirrored opening and focus knowledge frames make 69:26 an enacted failure to apprehend binding Reality.
The parallel speeches shift the contrast from predicting a verdict to expecting encounter and accepting a readable record.
Failed wealth-sufficiency and belief-and-feeding charges make the account an audit of supports, relations, and omissions.
The closing makes ignorance asymmetrical and temporary: denial covers what the evaluator knows until exposure yields regret and certainty.
summary.what_was_special: ح س ب moved among counting, supposition, sufficiency, and accountable supervision, while the split د ر ي mapping preserved a contained yield-and-return resonance beside direct knowing.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not force whether the book is identical with the account or evidence used in a distinct reckoning.
لَمْ أَدْرِ leaves open whether the speaker denied the account's existence, misunderstood its nature, or only lacked its outcome.
The move from rejected reminder or denial to self-produced ignorance is inferential rather than explicit in the focus grammar.
The yielded-return outlier depends on the split mapping to د ر ر and must remain qualified.
